explicit_non_claims: This note does not claim that a concrete four-manifold invariant has been established.
No source-backed nonzero homological Kirby-colour weight instance has been constructed.
No concrete category-bound event interpreter instance has been constructed.
The generic source-bound graphical eight-case compiler mechanism is established, but no concrete category-bound graphical rewrite instance has been constructed.
No concrete source-bound evaluator compiler instance has been constructed.
Handle-chain naturality is imported as one visible standard homology-domain axiom, not proved from serialized attaching maps.
The geometric semantics of presentation H2 certificates remain external to Lean.
The final H2 identity is derived in Lean and is not a field of either domain axiom.
Content hashes establish identity and freshness, not mathematical semantics.
This note does not identify the construction with Crane-Yetter or Yetter's state sum.

objective.acceptance_rule: Promotion requires concrete instances for the source-backed homological Kirby-colour coefficients, category-bound event interpreter, and source-bound graphical move compiler, followed by assembly of one hash-bound SourceBoundTableTwoEvaluatorCompiler and replay proving all eighteen target conditions established. The two visible domain axioms and a conditional Lean theorem alone are not a concrete invariant construction.
objective.goal: Construct a homologically twisted Kirby value for a marked closed connected smooth oriented four-manifold and prove that any two certified special Kirby presentations representing the same marked pair have equal normalized values.
objective.target_semantics: The desired output is a well-defined function of the marked oriented diffeomorphism class of the pair (X, alpha), defined through normalized Kirby evaluation and independent of all certified presentation choices.
